info.title: Wakeel Diary API
info.description: REST API for the Wakeel Diary mobile apps (clients, lawyers, law firms). Every endpoint calls the same services, policies and notifications as the web app. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

put.description: Fields left out keep their value. Changing the email sends a new verification code.

200.description: Profile saved.

message.example: The email has already been taken.

get.description: Whether two-factor authentication is on or waiting for confirmation.

200.description: OK

post.description: Requires the account password. Returns the secret key, otpauth:// URL and QR SVG for an authenticator app. Confirm with /account/two-factor/confirm.

message.example: Scan the QR code or enter the key in your authenticator app, then confirm with a code.

422.description: Validation error

200.description: Two-factor authentication is off.

422.description: Validation error

post.description: Turns two-factor on with a code from the authenticator app and returns recovery codes (show once).

200.description: Two-factor authentication is on.

422.description: Validation error

message.example: The provided two factor authentication code was invalid.

items.example: The provided two factor authentication code was invalid.

post.description: Requires the account password.

200.description: OK

post.description: Replaces all recovery codes. Requires the account password.

post.description: Email + password sign-in. If the account has two-factor authentication on, returns two_factor=true and a challenge_token (valid 10 minutes) instead of a token; finish with /auth/two-factor-challenge. Suspended accounts are refused. Throttled 5/min per email+IP.

200.description: Signed in.

422.description: Validation error

message.example: These credentials do not match our records.

items.example: These credentials do not match our records.

post.description: Send the challenge_token from /auth/login with either a 6-digit authenticator code or one recovery code (each recovery code works once).

post.description: Same rules as the web sign-up (CreateNewUser). lawyer/firm need cnic, bar_council_id and enrollment_number; firm also firm_name and firm_registration_number. A 6-digit verification code is emailed; verify with /auth/email/verify.

message.example: We can't find a user with that email address.

post.description: Exchanges the emailed 6-digit code for a reset_token used by /auth/reset-password. 5 wrong attempts invalidate the code.

422.description: Validation error

message.example: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest email or send a new code.
